clips.text: It is very easy to progress from one illusion to another because no foundational transformation is needed.
There is no shaking of the foundations because you remain the same.

So the real problem is not to change the objects of desire from the worldly to the other worldly but to transform oneself; not to change the seeking but to change the seeker - otherwise the problem remains as it is, it just takes new shapes.
But how to change the seeker?

First find out where it is and what it is, and then you will come to know a hidden secret: the seeker exists only while it is not sought, and when someone goes out to search for it - it is never found.
It exists only in ignorance and in darkness; in awareness it is not.
This realization of no-self is the jump.
